messages:
sam: kicking off staged rollout v2.7.0 -> canary 5% (us-west-2). change window 07:00-09:00 PT. release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.7.0 :rocket;

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT r-4234 started. target=canary:5% us-west-2. monitors: p95, 5xx, embed-sim. logstream: /rollouts/r-4234. :robot_face:;

lexi: smoke ok. quick A/B on 2 nodes for embed sims.

ops_lead: watch embed-sim delta >3pp or 5xx >1% sustained 5m.

lexi: noticing embed sim drop on a narrow product query family: baseline sim 0.91 -> 0.66 (sample N=30).

sam: paste log snippet and one example please.

lexi: example: "summarize pricing tiers for Z" expected sim 0.90 got 0.62. logs:
```
[07:12:10] embed svc node-4 req=a1 latency=150ms sim=0.62
[07:12:11] embed svc node-2 req=a2 latency=148ms sim=0.65
```

ops_lead: recommend HOLD and pin at 5%. need quick eval on critical prompt set before deciding rollback. rollback plan ready to v2.6.9.

deploy-bot: executing pin: `deploy-bot pin r-4234 --reason "embed-sim-drift"` -> pinned at 5%. audit: ops_lead at 4234567030.

sam: acknowledged. eval-bot queued ev-3301 for critical-embeds. ETA ~6m.

eval-bot: ev-3301 complete: pass_rate=89% baseline=94% delta=-5pp. flagged per policy. report: https://redwood/evals/ev-3301

ops_lead: decision: regresssion exceeds threshold; proceed rollback. any objections?

lexi: agree rollback. prepping failing cases and small patch.

sam: deploy-bot run rollback and notify CS. draft note: "Canary v2.7.0 paused due to embedding quality regression; reverting to v2.6.9 while we investigate."

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-4234 --to v2.6.9 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "embed-quality-regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. state=rolled_back. traffic reverted to v2.6.9. audit: sam at 4234567063.

ops_lead: postmortem actions: capture failing prompts, reproduce in staging, run small tokenizer patch A/B, and full eval before reattempt. meeting scheduled 10:30 PT.

cs-team: customer note queued. closing thread until remediation validated. :white_check_mark:
